source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Ensure the record is identified with the asset ID and any relevant descriptive text for example “Canteen toaster”, or "Office microwave".
3. Only enter the test results of the PAT that failed for the item, do not enter the results of the successful tests right on top of where the testing column of the failed results would be ideally positioned.
4. Refer to the back of your test record to identify current and relevant legislation on
   electrical safety that you can reference to help your case for the appliance testing.
5. Assist in the research and look for manufacturers instructions that support your current testing procedures.
6. Keep the item separate and in a holding area. Ensure that no users have access to these appliances until they are re-tested.
7. Follow up your test results – discuss and explain the appliance failures and how to resolve them.
8. If the appliance is new, please have the client approve replacement of the appliance with
